curios.modifiers.nightmare: When worn in the Nightmare slot:
curios.modifiers.blessing: When worn in a Blessing slot:
tooltip.nightmare_core.core.curse_lock: Cannot be removed in survival; only the Ember Blade can cut this bond.
tooltip.nightmare_core.core.chance: Kills and broken blocks have a %s%% + %s%% × Luck level chance to drop %s–%s fragments.
tooltip.nightmare_core.core.no_looting: Looting and Fortune do not affect this chance.
tooltip.nightmare_core.core.drops_disabl: Fragment drops are disabled in the config.
tooltip.nightmare_core.core.warning: Three blessings together still cannot fill the void the nightmare leaves behind.
tooltip.nightmare_core.core.curses: Seven curses: sleep nightmares, health recovery cap, damage decay, spawn restriction, awake double damage, darkness corrosion, insanity.
tooltip.nightmare_core.core.shift_hint: Hold Shift to read the curse effects
tooltip.nightmare_core.core.curse_suppre: Each blessing suppresses one curse; you only have three blessing slots.
curse.nightmare_core.sleep_nightmare.des: Entering a bed may summon a nightmare.
curse.nightmare_core.health_cap.desc: Health can only recover up to 10% of max, +10% per 20 levels, capped at 90%.
curse.nightmare_core.damage_penalty.desc: Damage to others is nullified at ≤5; above 5 it is reduced by 20%.
curse.nightmare_core.spawn_point.desc: Cannot set a spawn point unless hostiles are nearby.
curse.nightmare_core.awake_double_damage: Damage taken while awake is doubled.
curse.nightmare_core.darkness.desc: After 5 seconds below light 3, take 20% max health per second; never lethal.
curse.nightmare_core.insanity.desc: Seven days without sleep causes insanity: movement may reverse, attacks may hurt you.
tooltip.nightmare_core.blessing.final.em: With the core: max health is 80% of the original.
tooltip.nightmare_core.blessing.final.dr: With the core: net attack damage -2 (before weapon stats).
tooltip.nightmare_core.blessing.final.vi: With the core: armor is 80% of the original.
tooltip.nightmare_core.blessing.final.st: With the core: armor toughness is 80% of the original.
tooltip.nightmare_core.blessing.final.fl: With the core: movement speed is 80% of the original.
tooltip.nightmare_core.blessing.final.ec: With the core: attack speed is 105% of the original.
tooltip.nightmare_core.blessing.unique: Only one copy of each blessing may be worn.
tooltip.nightmare_core.blessing.note: Even empowered, a blessing cannot pay the nightmare's price.
tooltip.nightmare_core.blessing.ember_he: An ember relights inside the ventricle.
tooltip.nightmare_core.blessing.dreamren: A broken fang that can bite even dreams.
tooltip.nightmare_core.blessing.vigil_ca: The vigil never closes its eyes.
tooltip.nightmare_core.blessing.echo_bel: The bell rings only between sleep and waking.
tooltip.nightmare_core.charm.effect: When worn: +%s%% chance for nightmare fragments to drop.
tooltip.nightmare_core.charm.no_looting: Stacks with Luck level; Looting and Fortune do not affect it.
tooltip.nightmare_core.charm.flavor: It never blinks. It only watches the trail the nightmare leaves.
tooltip.nightmare_core.fragment.usage: An echo of the nightmare. Used to craft blessing trinkets and special tools.
tooltip.nightmare_core.fragment.source: Drops from kills and broken blocks while wearing the Nightmare Core.
tooltip.nightmare_core.prism.use: Reveals hostile mobs within 24 blocks and makes them glow for 20 seconds.
tooltip.nightmare_core.prism.cooldown: Cooldown: 60 seconds, or 5 seconds if nothing was found.
tooltip.nightmare_core.prism.flavor: A seam opens in the dream, and something inside looks back.
tooltip.nightmare_core.anchor.use: Use: return to the bound position (same dimension only).
tooltip.nightmare_core.anchor.cost: Each teleport costs 1 durability and has a 10 second cooldown.
tooltip.nightmare_core.ember_blade.use: Use on the Nightmare Core to sever the bond and remove it.
tooltip.nightmare_core.ember_blade.weapo: As a weapon: slightly stronger than a diamond sword.
tooltip.nightmare_core.ember_blade.cost: Each cut costs 64 durability (512 total) and deals 6 magic damage to you.
tooltip.nightmare_core.ember_blade.flavo: The embers on this edge are the one thing the nightmare fears.
tooltip.nightmare_core.blessing_bag.use: Use to receive one random basic blessing.
Embers harden into an undying crown.
The tide whispers from inside the pendant.
Through the rift, the dark becomes clear.
Its flame watches the dark for the vigil.
Only a refusal to fall remains in the shell.
message.nightmare_core.equipped: The nightmare opens its eye inside your chest.
message.nightmare_core.unequipped: The nightmare recedes, and the Blessing slots close.
message.nightmare_core.blessing.duplicat: Only one copy of each blessing may be worn.
message.nightmare_core.prism.revealed: The Nightmare Prism reveals %s hostile shadows.
message.nightmare_core.prism.none: No hostile shadows are close enough to reflect.
message.nightmare_core.anchor.bound: The Dream Anchor remembers this place.
message.nightmare_core.anchor.unbound: The Dream Anchor is unbound. Sneak-use it to bind this place.
message.nightmare_core.anchor.wrong_dime: The Dream Anchor can only return you to its bound dimension.
message.nightmare_core.anchor.blocked: The Dream Anchor's landing place is blocked.
message.nightmare_core.ember_blade.cut: The Ember Blade severs the nightmare's hold.
message.nightmare_core.ember_blade.no_co: There is no Nightmare Core in the Nightmare slot to cut.
message.nightmare_core.insanity: You have not slept for seven days. The world begins to twist.
message.nightmare_core.spawn_point.no_ho: No hostile creatures are nearby. The nightmare will not let you remember this place.
